## Summary

Roster candidates used a floor-based pick, and the single builtin boss bypassed selection entirely. Both differ from the recovered rounded sampler and shift later encounter/Setup randomness.

```text
roster pool → rounded 0..count-1 index
fresh boss gate → source 1..bossCount draw → construction / Setup → pose
```

Layer 3 originally followed [#136](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/136). The base is now master so this cumulative head can be accounted for by the single final merge. All five layers are assembled in [#139](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/139); validate and merge only that combined current head. Do not merge this PR individually. The existing offline pool policy and boss eligibility gate stay explicit.

## Evidence

- **Before:** all three new regressions fail. Raw 0.33 chooses the wrong entry in three-candidate builtin/saved pools, and a boss field starts with a Setup draw instead of source's 1..1 selection draw.
  **After:** the rounded candidate index and leading boss draw pass; the preceding complete Setup-before-pose assertions remain intact.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 922 unit tests / 8,478 assertions pass. The independent pcode-template audit still passes all 1,344 cases and visits all 99 constructor sites.
- Production build and all 14 affected mock/supplied-art browser cases pass with zero skips, flaky results or page errors. Accelerated pilots reach six upgrades, boss defeat, badge and Continue in 80,162 mock / 81,551 supplied-art frames. Native history/win/targeting paint inspected; owned servers stopped.
- Matching GetLocalTank / _-De bytecode and PlayerProfile's leading boss sentinel establish the selection contracts. [The source reference](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/blob/stack/wave-selection-03-encounter-selection/docs/wave-selection-reference.md#roster-candidate-indices-and-boss-selection) records exact commands, hashes, build and limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

No saved-data migration or original media.

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

Seeded encounters and subsequent RNG consumption change. Offline pool construction/order, retired server scheduling, empty/missing records and the complete constructor/art random stream remain separate limits. Seeded accelerated tests do not prove ordinary-input or original/Adobe/full-game equivalence. The branch retains the existing `stack/**` deployment control.

input.body:
## Summary

Shield Turrets treated active-array membership as parentage, reacquired during trigger, and applied Setup values to rejected births. This broke the recovered cached-reference contracts. The layer now retains physical target/home references and the source's cached-avatar read interruption.

```text
parent poll → EnemyAim → timer → trigger using existing rotation
cached target = avatar → missing inner_mc read → end this listener
closed birth gate → same unparented constructor object, no Setup
```

Layer 4 originally followed [#137](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/137). The base is now master so this cumulative head can be accounted for by the single final merge. All five layers are assembled in [#139](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/139); validate and merge only that combined current head. Do not merge this PR individually.

## Evidence

- **Before:** five initial contract regressions fail; an additional missing-home regression rejects UID fallback.
  **After:** all seven new contract cases pass, including actual-parent shielding, detached target transforms, signed-zero/random aim, trigger ordering, home parentage and rejected defaults.
- Three controlled probes call original methods on original objects in Ruffle. They preserve both original ABC payloads and all other nonbinding tag payloads, verified independently. Normal and named-part avatars produce ReferenceError #1069 in the original EnemyAim; the rejected-birth probe returns the same unparented zero-pose object with NaN speed and constructor defaults. Loaded JS/WASM bytes match installed runtime bytes. These are controlled calls, not an ordinary original cached encounter or Adobe proof.
- Formatting, TypeScript and all 929 unit tests / 8,513 assertions pass.
- Production build and all 18 affected mock/supplied-art browser cases pass with zero skips, flaky results or page errors. The turret gallery retains its six previous clip/frame/paint checks and adds cached shield/counter/sound/artwork checks. Both modes were inspected; all owned probe and validation processes stopped.
- [The source/runtime reference](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/blob/stack/wave-selection-04-turret-contracts/docs/shield-turret-retention-reference.md) records commands, hashes, build, observed results, source-derived inferences and remaining limits. No SWF/probe output, original media or build artifacts are committed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

No saved-data migration.

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

Cached avatar targeting now interrupts the modeled listener as the recovered call chain requires; shielding from an old parented turret remains. Physical removal, separate artwork and source-scoped RemoveBullet stay distinct. The optional saved-enemy caller is proven; builtin catalogs contain no 4032. Arbitrary matrices, complete constructor/event/RNG scheduling, ordinary earned encounters and synchronized original/Adobe/full-game parity remain unfinished.

The existing `stack/**` deployment control remains in place.

Created with gpt-6.1-sol in T3 Code's Codex harness.
